title: Position: AI Development Should Prioritize Cognitive Security
authors: Batu El*, Shiye Su*, Aneesh Pappu*, Peggy Yin*, Julie Heng*, Eric Heng, Ryan Wang, Andreas Haupt, James Zou
abstract: We argue that AI safety should expand beyond alignment and oversight to include the protection of human cognition — the perceptions, beliefs, and decisions that AI systems increasingly mediate. We define cognitive security, sketch its threat model, and outline concrete research and policy directions.
